# iosxe_voice_class_dpg (Data Source)

This data source can read the Voice Class DPG configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_voice_class_dpg" "example" {
  tag = 200
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (Number) Voice class dialpeer group tag

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `dial_peers` (Attributes List) Add a dialpeer to the group (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dial_peers))
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Put dial-peer group to inactive state

<a id="nestedatt--dial_peers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dial_peers`

Read-Only:

- `dial_peer_id` (String) Voice dial-peer tag
- `preference` (Number) Preference order of this dialpeer in a group
